name: Free Draw
desc:
Welcome to Free Draw, a community drawing hangout. Draw with your friends or show off your work to others — the tools are in your hands!

Rules:
• All content must be appropriate for the Roblox platform.
• No Griefing — Don't touch other people's art without their permission.
• No Scribbling — Refrain from excessively scribbling over the canvas.
• No Toxicity — Be nice to others.
